title: Every chef needs one of these!
text: Every chef needs one of these!. I have been using this as a dough cutter for about a month now. I love to bake and make my own crusts, so I like to make a lot at one time and freeze the extra. This pastry cutter is great. It fits well in my hand and maneuvers easily. Cuts and presses the dough flawlessly. Clean up is also a breeze. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Stainless Steel Pastry Scraper Bench Scraper Chopper, Best as Pizza and Dough Cutter (Purple, 6 Inch)
features: 【Material】: Made of high quality stainless steel, firm and not flimsy. It is sharp enough to cut through chilled pastry scraper dough easily.

【Great For More Than Just Scraping Dough】: Use it to gently chop soft fruits and veggies, avocados, cut even brownies, cut dough for pastries/cinnamon rolls/dinner rolls/pizza/pasta and cookies, scoop up chopped vegetables or herbs to transfer to a pot, clean counters of crumbs and dried dough, smooth out frosting on cakes or use as a mini cake lifter. Lift pie dough, chop nuts, mash cooked beans or hard boiled eggs, temper chocolate, chop grilled chicken, divvy up butter and much more!

【Multifunctional Dough Tools】 : It not only can cut dough, bread, cake, cream, pizza and baking, also can cut homemade caramels, soap, cinnamon rolls, jelly rolls, brownies, rice crispy treats, dessert bars and more!
【Comfortable Grip】: Comfortably contoured, nonslip handle; dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup
【Fit Height】: Tall enough to keep hands away from food.
